title: "Search"

## Search posts

<link href="/pagefind/pagefind-ui.css" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="/pagefind/pagefind-ui.js"></script>
<div id="search"></div>

<script>
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const ui = new PagefindUI({
      element: '#search',
      showImages: false,
      openFilters: ['Categories']
    });
    const query = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('query');
    if (query) ui.triggerSearch(query);
  });
</script>

## Searching comments

Looking for something in the comments? Post comments are stored as GitHub Discussions and can be searched directly on GitHub at [github.com/mattwagers/roundup-sandbox/discussions](https://github.com/mattwagers/roundup-sandbox/discussions).
